response.sql: WITH linked_signals AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex FROM linked_signals), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM linked_signals GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT tw.weathprofile, AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(tw.avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg, AVG(tw.avg_modindex - ov.overall_avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_overall FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN overall AS ov WHERE tw.avg_modindex > ov.overall_avg_modindex GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
